post.summary: Preview one entity's Risk Score under a saved or unsaved model, writing nothing
post.description: ASSURE-RISK-SCORE-RESIDUALS-1 S3. Gated on canWorkIncidents; unsaved content also needs canAuthorWorkbench. Body: exactly one of model (a saved id) or content (a risk-score model), plus entityKey (1-256 chars). Every factor is narrowed to the entity; evaluation is bounded (one row per indicator, 3 evidence rows per factor, a 10 s sandbox timeout). No scores Dataset, Signal or watch-list entry is written. Classified evidence is masked; the entity key is masked unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {model, entityType, entityKey, keyMasked, found, score, high, highThreshold, saved, factors[{indicator, label, value, missing, weight, cap, capped, contribution, evidence[]}]}

400.description: Not exactly one of model/content, or a missing or over-long entityKey.

403.description: The caller lacks canWorkIncidents, or canAuthorWorkbench for unsaved content, or previews content outside its data scopes.

404.description: The saved model is unknown, unparseable or outside the caller's data scopes.

422.description: The content fails the save-time checks, or a factor query fails.

503.description: No Space write or data root.

get.summary: The latest Risk Score of one entity under a saved risk-score model, with its factors
get.description: ASSURE-RISK-SCORE-1. Gated on canWorkIncidents. An unknown model, a model outside the caller's data scopes, a row the policy engine denies, or no score for the entity are all 404 (existence-hiding). score = sum of factor contributions (weight x indicator, held to cap), clamped 0-100; every score is recomputable from its factors. The entity key is returned as the Space masked: token (keyMasked: true) unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities; classified evidence is masked at write time.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {model, entityType, entityKey, score, high, highThreshold, modelVersion, runId, scoredAt, factors[{indicator, label, value, missing, weight, cap, capped, contribution, evidence[]}]}

404.description: No visible score for that model and entity.
